case.name: Investment Assistant
case.business_problem: Help customers understand portfolio information and initiate investment workflows safely.
case.desired_outcome: Fast grounded answers with controlled transactional side effects.
case.quality_target: High groundedness and task success on investment queries
case.latency_target: Low latency for read-only requests; higher budget for complex analysis
case.cost_constraint: Up to $800/month at current query volume
case.regulatory_constraints: Suitability, auditability and human/user confirmation before transactional side effects
case.roi_notes: Efficiency: cuts average portfolio-question handling time from ~6 minutes (human) to under 30 seconds. Productivity: frees advisors to focus on complex/high-value cases. Solution cost: estimated at $650/month at current volume, within the $800 budget ceiling.

tradeoff_notes: Workflow is simpler and more auditable but can't dynamically choose which internal tool/API to call for ad-hoc portfolio questions; multi-agent adds coordination overhead we don't need yet. Revisit if the catalog of callable tools grows beyond a handful.

notes.Managed API provider: Strong on complex reasoning and tool use
notes.Self-hosted open-weight: Good enough for routine queries, weaker on edge cases
Upfront infra cost, lower marginal cost at volume
